note_on_unsynchronized: RFC 5545 3.8.5.3 declares the recurrence set undefined when DTSTART is not synchronized with the rule. Those cases are excluded from the scored 1721-case conformance set and are NOT claimed as defects here; they are retained only to show the behaviour is the same shape.
horizon_note: Per-case differences are computed over ~400 occurrences of each reading, truncated to a common horizon so that prefix truncation cannot fake a difference. The corpus's own comparison window is much shorter, which is why a spurious date can push a required one out of the compared prefix without the rule omitting it.
